text: Figure 1.1: Ethernet stack module overview Note: The Ethernet Interface is specified in a way that allows for object code delivery of the code module, following the "one-fits-all" principle, i.e. the entire configuration of the Ethernet Interface can be carried out without modifying any source code. Thus, the configuration of the Ethernet Interface can be carried out largely without detailed knowledge of the underlying hardware.
